description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the CountryService class within the OrangeHRM admin service module. It tests various functionalities such as retrieving, setting, and querying country and province data, as well as converting country list to an array format.

classes.name: CountryServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the CountryService, testing retrieval and conversion methods for country and province data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test with an instance of CountryService.

methods.name: testGetCountryDao
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of the CountryDao object from the service.

methods.name: testSetCountryDao
methods.description: Tests setting a custom CountryDao object into the service.

methods.name: testGetCountryList
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly retrieves a list of Country entities.

methods.name: testGetProvinceList
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly retrieves a list of Province entities.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Ensures the service can fetch a Country by name, returning null if not found.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Ensures the service can fetch a Country by code, returning null if not found.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Ensures the service can fetch a Province by code, returning null if not found.

methods.name: testGetCountryArray
methods.description: Tests conversion of country list to an array suitable for dropdowns or UI display.
